subject: Schedule hook: recordOrchestratorClimatologyTrial from shadow-evaluation-pass when n>=100
body:
386bfc9 on hermes/2026-09-18-queues.

The rung-2 instrument and the hash chain are in packages (grok). The
schedule lives in your domain: apps/web/lib/ops/shadow-evaluation-pass.ts
already constructs LiveOrchestrator on the refresh-odds cron.

When a scope has >= 100 settled ShadowSignal rows, run
measureOrchestratorVsClimatology on those as-of (home, away, y) tuples —
particleFilterProb recorded BEFORE settle — then
recordOrchestratorClimatologyTrial. Do not pass marketHomeProb into the
scorecard. Do not invent a p-value from BSS.

I will not reach into apps/web.
